description: The TPS61088 is a high-power density, fully- integrated synchronous boost converter with a 11-mΩ power switch and a 13-mΩ rectifier switch to provide a high efficiency and small size solution in portable systems. The TPS61088 has a wide input voltage range from 2.7 V to 12 V to support applications with single-cell or two-cell Lithium batteries. The device has 10-A switch current capability and is capable of providing an output voltage up to 12.6 V. features: Up to 91% efficiency at VIN = 3.3 V, VOUT = 9 V, and IOUT = 3 A
Mode selection between PFM mode and forced PWM mode at light load
1.0-µA current into the VIN pin during shutdown
Adjustable switching frequency: 200 kHz to 2.2 MHz
Create a custom design using the TPS61088 with the WEBENCH Power Designer

pinout.name: VCC
pinout.desc: Output of the internal regulator. A ceramic capacitor of more than 1.0 µF is required between this pin and ground.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.desc: Enable logic input. Logic high level enables the device. Logic low level disables the device and turns it into shutdown mode.

pinout.name: FSW
pinout.desc: The switching frequency is programmed by a resistor between this pin and the SW pin.

pinout.name: SW
pinout.desc: The switching node pin of the converter. It is connected to the drain of the internal low-side power MOSFET and the source of the internal high-side power MOSFET.

pinout.name: BOOT
pinout.desc: Power supply for high-side MOSFET gate driver. A ceramic capacitor of 0.1 µF must be connected between this pin and the SW pin.

pinout.name: SS
pinout.desc: Soft-start programming pin. An external capacitor sets the ramp rate of the reference voltage of the internal error amplifier during soft start.

pinout.name: NC
pinout.desc: No connection inside the device. Connect these two pins to the ground plane on the PCB for good thermal dissipation.

pinout.name: MODE
pinout.desc: Operation mode selection pin for the device in light load condition. When this pin is connected to ground, the device works in PWM mode. When this pin is left floating, the device works in PFM mode.

pinout.name: FB
pinout.desc: Voltage feedback. Connect to the center tape of a resistor divider to program the output voltage.

pinout.name: COMP
pinout.desc: Output of the internal error amplifier, the loop compensation network must be connected between this pin and the AGND pin.

pinout.name: ILIM
pinout.desc: Adjustable switch peak current limit. An external resistor must be connected between this pin and the AGND pin.

pinout.name: PGND
pinout.desc: Power ground of the IC. It is connected to the source of the low-side MOSFET.

design_procedure.intent: The switching frequency is set by a resistor connected between the FSW pin and the SW pin of the TPS61088.
vars: RFREQ = the resistance connected between the FSW pin and the SW pin

design_procedure.intent: The peak input current is set by selecting the correct external resistor value correlating to the required current limit.
vars: RILIM = the resistance connected between the ILIM pin and ground
ILIM = the switching peak current limit

design_procedure.intent: Three most important specifications to the performance of the inductor are the inductor value, DC resistance, and saturation current.
For small output voltage ripple, TI recommends a low-ESR output capacitor like a ceramic capacitor.
vars: Vripple_dis = output voltage ripple caused by charging and discharging of the output capacitor
Vripple_ESR = output voltage ripple caused by ESR of the output capacitor
VIN_MIN = the minimum input voltage of boost converter
ILpeak = the peak current of the inductor
RC_ESR = the ESR of the output capacitors

design_procedure.intent: For good input voltage filtering, TI recommends low-ESR ceramic capacitors.
The output voltage is set by an external resistor divider (R1, R2 in Figure 8-1).

curve_interpretation: Akım limiti ayar direnciyle azalıyor (90→349 kΩ, 13.1→3.3 A). Eğriden: R=100kΩ→11.9A, R=250kΩ→4.6A.
Anahtarlama frekansı ayar direnciyle değişiyor (50→787 kΩ, 216→1916).
Vref ≈ 1.204 V; -40…125 °C aralığında toplam sapma ~1.7 mV → referans çok kararlı.
Sükunet akımı Iq 94…119 µA; sıcaklıkla artıyor (-40→84 °C).
layout_guidelines: If layout is not carefully done, the regulator could suffer from instability and noise problems.
To maximize efficiency, switch rise and fall times are very fast.
To prevent radiation of high- frequency noise (for example, EMI), proper layout of the high-frequency switching path is essential.
Minimize the length and area of all traces connected to the SW pin, and always use a ground plane under the switching regulator to minimize interplane coupling.
The input capacitor needs to be close to the VIN pin and GND pin in order to reduce the Iinput supply ripple.
The layout should also be done with well consideration of the thermal as this is a high power density device.
A thermal pad that improves the thermal capabilities of the package should be soldered to the large ground plate, using thermal vias underneath the thermal pad.
